attributes.title: PacVet 2027
attributes.summary:
PacVet 2027, the California VMA's 20th-anniversary Pacific Veterinary Conference, runs June 3 to 6, 2027, at the Town and Country Resort in San Diego. It is open to veterinarians, new graduates, RVTs, practice managers, hospital staff and students, with in-person, virtual and hybrid registration options.

Full four-day registration for veterinarians costs $625 (CVMA member, early) up to $865 (non-member, onsite); fees listed here are veterinarian rates, with lower prices for technicians, staff and students. Early registration opens November 16, 2026. Rooms at the resort are $269 per night until May 2, 2027.
